display.purpose: The filename H1. Archivo wdth 112, wght 700. Desktop cap 3.7rem so the filename fits the 42rem column.

code.purpose: Filenames, versions, figure labels, table headers, RFC 2119 levels, and the inlined example file.

motion.name: fig-draw
motion.description: Home wide-figure leader lines draw left to right, 60ms apart, 240ms each. Disabled when prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 1.25rem; border-radius: 0; background: oklch(0.145 0 0); color: oklch(1 0 0); font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.145 0 0) 88%, oklch(1 0 0)); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.145 0 0); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 1.25rem; border-radius: 0; border: 1px solid oklch(0.145 0 0 / 45%); background: transparent; color: oklch(0.145 0 0); font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { border-color: oklch(0.145 0 0); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.145 0 0); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Nav link
components.description: Mono, quiet until current or hover. Current uses a hairline, not an underline.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 2.75rem; color: oklch(0.45 0 0); font-family: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link[aria-current="page"] { color: oklch(0.145 0 0); }

narrative.overview: The site reads as a technical document, not a landing page. Hairlines, a measured drawing of the voice file generated from SECTIONS, and a fingerprint mark that exists only on favicon and OG. Dark default is true black. No accent color.
keyCharacteristics: Dark .dark by default, light html via the header switch. Dark ground is oklch(0 0 0).
One reading axis. H1, one sentence, two buttons, then the drawing.
Mobile-first at 390px. Structure SVG visible at every width. Horizontal nav from 1280px.

rules.name: The No-Accent Rule
rules.body: The interface has no accent color. The only color is the fingerprint gradient on favicon and OG.

rules.name: The Filename-Is-The-Display Rule
rules.body: The H1 is the product name. Do not add a kicker above it.

rules.name: The Hairline-Or-Space Rule
rules.body: Pick a border or a gap. Do not stack both to fake a card.

rules.name: The Every-Line-Means-Something Rule
rules.body: A line points, bounds, or separates. If you can delete it without losing information, delete it.

dos: Do keep the home lede as One open Markdown file that teaches any AI your voice.
Do keep the structure SVG visible at every width.
Do cut a sentence rather than add a section.
donts: Don't mention AGENTS.md on home or load. FAQ and the spec may.
Don't restore zinc HSL 240 10% tokens, hsl(var(, DM Sans, or preset b2YPlg.
Don't nest cards or add a Why essay.
Don't put a kicker or eyebrow above the H1.
Don't add a generator, loader, account, or Supervised/Jeroen branding.
Don't hide the structure SVG with display:none under 64rem as the only mobile UI.
